_: THE MASTER GRID. It gives common alignment lines. IT DOES NOT DECIDE THE COMPOSITION. Composition is a PAGE PATTERN choosing named slots; the grid only says where their edges may fall. This is the distinction the previous three attempts kept losing: every time the grid was given a little more responsibility it ended up designing the page from measurements.
notLayout: A grid that is allowed to answer 'should these two things sit beside each other?' or 'how big should this be?' is a resolver. This one answers only 'where may an edge fall?'.
why12: Not because 12 is magical, but because it divides cleanly into the compositions courseware actually needs: 12 · 8+4 · 7+5 · 6+6 · 4+4+4 · 3+6+3. Eight columns reduce to 6+2 · 5+3 · 4+4; four columns to 2+2 and, in practice, to one stacked column.

columns._: span(n) in px, 1-indexed. The CSS uses repeat(N, minmax(0,1fr)) so these are what the grid produces, not what it is told; they are published because a pattern is designed against them.

vertical.rule: AUTO. Rows grow with their content. THE PAGE SCROLLS.
vertical.never: The page is never fitted to the viewport height, and a tall page is never a failed layout. Height is not an optimisation target and is not an input to any decision.
vertical._: One spatial unit and repeated multiples, so gutters, padding and vertical rhythm stay coherent.

readingMeasure._: PROSE IS NEVER SET WIDER THAN 760px. On this grid that is EXACTLY eight desktop columns — the 12-column grid at 1152 with 24px gutters lands on the measure the previous atlas had already arrived at from typography alone. A slot that may hold prose may not exceed the spans above, and the build refuses a pattern that breaks it.

whitespace.readingMargin: Free width OUTSIDE a pattern's slots is reading margin and is legitimate.
whitespace.residue: Free width INSIDE a named slot, left over because the arithmetic worked out that way, is LAYOUT RESIDUE and is a defect. It is fixed by choosing a different approved subdesign, never by measuring the content.
whitespace.designed: Emptiness that is part of the composition is declared by a slot with occupancy `optional-reserved`, and has to be justified.
